tracks.en:
1
00:00:00,400 --> 00:00:22,050
Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.

2
00:00:22,050 --> 00:00:34,140
Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.

3
00:00:34,140 --> 00:00:51,800
Their reward with their Lord will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow,

4
00:00:51,800 --> 00:00:59,979
wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
